description: Per-hit collision-shape and offset animation parameters, selected by DamageDataTable.Id_CollisionModify and applied by the attack component collision-parameter block.

Id.simple: Row identifier used by damage rows to select this modification.
Id.technical: FName key in CollisionModifyDataTable. FGameCollisionParameter::Setup skips the lookup when DamageRow->Id_CollisionModify is None, otherwise scans CollisionModifyDataTables in order and takes the first UDataTable::FindRow match; the export labels this key ID, while the Unreal property is Id (case-insensitive generator match).

Size.simple: Target collision extents (or radius/height inputs for spheres and capsules).
Size.technical: FVector target size. TickSize returns early when this is exactly zero. For boxes it lerps cached OriginalSize to Size component-wise and sets box extent; for spheres it averages X/Y/Z of both vectors and sets sphere radius; for capsules it averages X/Y for radius and uses Z as half-height. Units are Unreal world units; exported examples include (90,90,200) and (70,70,200).

Size_Time.simple: Duration over which the collision size reaches Size.
Size_Time.technical: Seconds. CollisionParameter_Alpha yields 1 when Time<=0, otherwise clamps Elapsed/Time to [0,1]; SizeElapsed advances by DeltaTime multiplied by owner CustomTimeDilation after alpha is computed. Zero/negative therefore applies the target size immediately on the first tick; default 0.

Size_WaitTime.simple: Delay before the size animation starts.
Size_WaitTime.technical: Seconds, cached into FGameCollisionParameter::SizeWaitTime at Setup. While positive, TickSize subtracts scaled DeltaTime and returns without changing shape; default 0 (no delay).

Location.simple: Target relative offset applied to the collision component.
Location.technical: FVector offset in Unreal world units before rotation. TickLocation returns when exactly zero; otherwise it rotates Location * Alpha by the cached extra frame (Rotation130 composed with either the component relative rotation, or identity when bLocation_AbsoluteRotation is true) and adds OriginalLocation.

Location_Time.simple: Duration over which the collision offset reaches Location.
Location_Time.technical: Seconds. Same CollisionParameter_Alpha rule as Size_Time: non-positive duration gives alpha 1 immediately; positive duration ramps Elapsed/Time. LocationElapsed advances by scaled DeltaTime after alpha computation; default 0.

Location_WaitTime.simple: Delay before the offset animation starts.
Location_WaitTime.technical: Seconds, cached into FGameCollisionParameter::LocationWaitTime at Setup. While positive, TickLocation subtracts scaled DeltaTime and returns without changing relative location; default 0.

bLocation_AbsoluteRotation.simple: Whether the Location offset is interpreted without the component's relative rotation.
bLocation_AbsoluteRotation.technical: When true, TickLocation uses FRotator::ZeroRotator as the base instead of Component->GetRelativeRotation() before composing cached Rotation130. Affects only the Location offset; default false.

Life_Time.simple: Lifetime after which collision is disabled and the OnHit delegate fires.
Life_Time.technical: Seconds, copied at Setup with `Life_Time != 0 ? Life_Time : -1`, so exported/default 0 means unlimited (-1, no countdown). Positive values count down by scaled DeltaTime; at <=0 collision is set to NoCollision, OnHit is broadcast and cleared. Negative source values remain negative/unlimited.

notes: Single retail table name CollisionModifyDataTable; AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves exactly that primary asset into CollisionModifyDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:243, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:154).
The row is cached by pointer in FGameCollisionParameter::CollisionModifyRow when the damage row is armed and cleared by Reset (Source/Abrams/Private/GameCollisionParameterInterface.cpp:37,52,74,85).

All visible consumers are static C++ reconstruction. The available Content is partial, so direct Blueprint or other table consumers cannot be excluded; no uncooked asset guesses are used as semantic evidence.
Exported values confirm the serialized schema and representative values but do not by themselves establish meaning.

usages.detail: FGameCollisionParameter::Setup takes a Damage row, resolves its Id_CollisionModify into a cached CollisionModify row, and seeds wait/lifetime state.
TickSize animates box extent, sphere radius, or capsule radius/half-height toward Size using Size_WaitTime/Size_Time.
TickLocation animates a relative component offset toward Location using Location_WaitTime/Location_Time and the rotation flag.
Tick applies all timing with owner CustomTimeDilation and expires collision after Life_Time.
Manager load/registry path for the sole CollisionModifyDataTable asset.
